description: This file defines a feature in a C# ASP.NET Core application for listing tags. It includes a request query class, a request handler that fetches tag data from a database context, and returns an envelope containing a list of tag IDs.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A request object implementing IRequest, representing a query for retrieving tags.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query, interacts with the database context to retrieve tags ordered by TagId, and returns a TagsEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method processing the query, fetching tags from the database, and returning a tags envelope.
